title: Participe Présent in French Grammar: The Complete TCF/TEF Guide
excerpt: How to form the participe présent, its only three irregulars, the three uses that follow opposite agreement rules, and the invariability mistake that costs the most marks in TCF/TEF writing.
meta_description: Participe présent explained for TCF/TEF Canada: the nous-form rule, the 3 irregulars (étant, ayant, sachant), gérondif vs adjectif verbal, and when it agrees.
